text:
I applied your answers and saved the document. It still has 12 requirements.

- **Bookings in the past:** Booking a slot that starts in the past is rejected (REQ-002).
- **Started bookings:** Users can't cancel or change a booking once it has started (REQ-004, REQ-010).
- **Ownership:** A booking belongs to the email stored with it (REQ-004, REQ-008). Someone who clears browser data or switches browser can't manage their old bookings, so an admin cancels them.
- **Time zone and end time:** The 07:00–20:00 window uses Europe/Zurich time, and a booking may end exactly at 20:00 (REQ-007).
- **Deactivated rooms:** Existing future bookings stay valid and only new bookings are blocked (REQ-012).
- **Out of scope:** I added emails of any kind, including cancellation links and notifications. I also added recovering ownership after browser data is cleared.

I haven't recorded any assumptions.
